_doc: Scene types for SceneGen. params override MapGen.DEFAULTS (w/h in squares of 2 m; floors = tallest structure). A scene's turrets: {"<security>": chance} is at least the chance for every building's turrets (Furnish.has_turrets: the corporate campus, where military locations play, is armed). params.deploy: where the crew starts (SceneGen._deploy_zone): "near" a short walk from the target building's street door (across the street), or "far" at the street spawn farthest from it (open ground and stealth approaches); a set piece's params can override it. The planner code lives in src/gen/scene_gen.gd.

skirmish.name: Skirmish
skirmish.desc: Small test map for greybox and visual work: one two-storey bar on a street, a back alley, a few crates. Guards start close.

street_block.name: Street block
street_block.desc: A few city blocks from the mixed-residential profile: grid with the odd diagonal or curve, mixed buildings and lots.

megablock.name: Megablock
megablock.desc: Apartment tower over a courtyard, parking and a corner shop.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.desc: Moored cargo ship, quay cranes, fenced container yard, warehouse and gate booth.

badlands.name: Badlands raider camp
badlands.desc: Open desert with rock outcrops, a riverbed, wrecks and a fenced raider camp.

rail_yard.name: Rail yard
rail_yard.desc: Stopped train you can board, freight cars on parallel tracks, platform and station.

corp_campus.name: Corporate campus
corp_campus.desc: Fenced grounds, gate booth, parking, plaza, HQ tower and service building.

city_district.name: City district
city_district.desc: Tech demo: a 4 × 3 grid of city blocks cut by a diagonal avenue, about 40 buildings, skybridges and footbridges.

neighborhood.name: Neighbourhood
neighborhood.desc: Any Night City neighbourhood profile from data/gen/districts.json (params.profile).

undercity.name: Undercity
undercity.desc: Storm drains and maintenance tunnels under the city: runoff channels with plank crossings, a cistern, pump rooms and service tunnels, and the target sealed in a vault chamber at the far end. Sodium work lamps and a sick green glow.

arcology.name: Arcology concourse
arcology.desc: The floor of a corporate arcology's atrium: white stone promenade round a reflecting pool, boutiques and a clinic on both sides, a service lane in, and the corp's offices behind a security line. Cold light, corporate red.

warzone.name: Burning combat zone
warzone.desc: A combat zone at dusk with the fighting still going: ruined blocks, burning wrecks and buildings, smoke over the streets, the power out.
